about_short_description.short_description: AI accounting for enterprise finance teams

product.name: Invoice Processing Automation Platform
product.description: A platform that automates invoice reading, verification, coding, approval, and ERP posting using AI agents tailored to company-specific processes.

product.name: Inbox Management
product.description: A service to capture and record all incoming invoice documents in multiple formats and enable automated vendor communication.

product.name: Invoice Review
product.description: An AI-driven process that reads invoices with high accuracy and performs automated compliance, tax, and fraud checks.

product.name: Account Allocation
product.description: An AI-based system that assigns general ledger accounts and prepares journal entries for ERP systems based on learned accounting schemes.

product.name: Approval Workflow Automation
product.description: A system that automatically allocates cost centers and manages invoice approval processes based on due dates, discount periods, and amount thresholds.
